svg.title: The Bhagavad Gītā inside the Mahābhārata
svg.desc: Three nested boxes. The outer box is the Mahābhārata. Inside it is its sixth book, the Bhīṣma-parvan. Inside that, highlighted, is the Bhagavad Gītā, 18 chapters and 700 verses. A note above it gives the Gītā’s place in book 6: it is chapters 23 to 40 in the critical edition, or 25 to 42 in other recensions.
